issues.title: Workflow Issues
issues.no_workflows_hint: Create or copy a workflow before viewing its issues.
issues.empty_hint: Issues appear here when this workflow starts a run for them.

create.title: Create workflow
create.description: Create a blank draft manually or let Codex break your description into agent steps.
create.key_hint: A stable identifier using lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.
create.key_invalid: Start with a letter or number and use only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.
create.unreadable: The workflow was created, but its details could not be read. Open it from the workflows list.

ai.no_codex_runtime: No usable online Codex runtime is available. Connect or start Codex first.
ai.request_placeholder: For example: Receive a bug report, have an agent reproduce and diagnose it, another agent implement the fix, then review the result and return rejected work for revision.
ai.request_hint: Include the goal, important stages, inputs, review rules, and when work should be sent back.
ai.start_failed: Failed to start the Codex workflow builder
ai.no_draft: Codex finished without returning a workflow draft. Refine the description and try again.
ai.invalid_draft: Codex returned a workflow that did not pass validation.
ai.timeout: Workflow generation timed out. Try again with a shorter description.
ai.generating: Codex is breaking down the workflow…
ai.generating_hint: This can take a minute. The workflow is not created until you review it.
ai.review_hint: Review the generated stages. After creation, you can edit routing, instructions, inputs, and limits in the workflow editor.

empty.title: No workflows yet
empty.hint: A workflow is a pinned graph of agent steps with acceptance and bounded rework.

detail.toast_duplicate_unreadable: The workflow was duplicated, but its details could not be read. Open it from the workflows list.

graph.rework_label: On failure, send work back to
graph.rework_none: Rework is not permitted from this step

limits.note: Snapshotted when a run starts, so tightening policy later cannot invalidate a run already in flight.

json_view.hint: Edit the raw graph. Fields the canvas does not render — submission schemas, acceptance criteria, limits — can only be changed here.
json_view.read_only_hint: The raw graph of this workflow, read-only.
json_view.stale_notice: The graph changed on the canvas while these edits were unapplied. Applying now replaces that change.

add_node.input_exists: This workflow already has an intake step. A run has one input, collected at the entry step, so only one is meaningful.

empty.title: No step selected
empty.hint: Pick a step on the canvas to edit its name, routing and prompt.

input.title: Nothing else to configure
input.hint: An intake step is filled in by a person, so it has no agent, no expected submission and nothing can be sent back to it - use an acceptance step to ask a human something mid-run.

input_mode.image_hint: Choose an image once here. It is saved with the workflow and reused automatically when the workflow runs.
input_mode.image_invalid_type: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image.
input_mode.image_too_large: The image must be 100 MB or smaller.

input_fields.hint: What the Run dialog asks for. The order here is the order of the form, and the order the values reach the first agent.
input_fields.empty: No fields declared. The run still asks for a title and a description; declare fields to ask for more.
input_fields.key_required: A field needs a key: it is where the submitted value is stored.
input_fields.key_duplicate: Another field already uses the key "{{key}}", and the second value would overwrite the first.
input_fields.key_hint: A key names a slot in the run's input. Runs already started keep the version they pinned, but anything outside this app that sends this key by name - the intake endpoint, a script - stops being read after a rename.
input_fields.label_placeholder: What the person is asked for
input_fields.options_required: A pick-one field needs at least one choice, or the Run dialog has nothing to offer.
input_fields.option_placeholder: One value the person may pick
input_fields.option_blank: A blank choice cannot be told apart from nothing being picked.

end.title: Nothing to configure
end.hint: An End step finishes the run. It has no agent, no prompt and no outgoing edges.

unknown.title: Unsupported step type "{{type}}"
unknown.hint: This step was authored by a newer server. It is shown so it survives a save, but this build cannot edit it - use the JSON view.

basic.key_locked_hint: The key cannot be changed: every edge, rework target and run already refers to this step by it.
basic.name: Name

routing.strategy_required: Pick a strategy: an agent step cannot run without one.
routing.agent_empty: This workspace has no agents yet.
routing.from_node_aria: Step to reuse the agent from
routing.from_node_empty: No other agent step to reuse an agent from.
routing.from_node_required: Pick the step whose agent this one reuses.
routing.fallback_hint: Optional. Used last, when the strategy above resolves nobody.

prompt.instruction_hint: Sent to the agent as the step's brief. This is the step's only free-text field.
prompt.instruction_placeholder: What the agent must do, and what counts as done

submission.label: Expected submission
submission.hint: The shape the step must report back in, so the next step can route on it.

acceptance.empty: No criteria yet. A reviewer with no criteria has nothing to check.
acceptance.placeholder: What must be true to accept this work

branches.required: A condition step needs at least one branch.

failure.label: When this step fails
failure.hint: Decides what the run does with a failed step.
failure.rework_targets_hint: Choose one or more reachable upstream steps. These are the only steps the run may loop back to.
failure.rework_targets_empty: Connect this step after an eligible upstream work step; it will appear here.
failure.rework_targets_required: Rework needs at least one target, or the run has no legal move.
failure.rework_targets_required_acceptance: An acceptance step needs at least one target, so a rejection can route somewhere.
failure.rework_targets_invalid: These targets are not reachable upstream steps: {{targets}}. Clear them and choose an eligible target.

input_editor.placeholder: Enter the background, goals, requirements, or other key information…
input_editor.name: Name

empty.title: No runs yet
empty.hint: Open a workflow and press Run. Every run pins the published graph it started from, so what ran stays readable afterwards.

reason.routing_no_candidate: No eligible agent could run this step. The run stopped rather than handing the work to the wrong specialist.
reason.submission_contract_invalid: The agent reply did not satisfy the submission format. Review the original reply and validation details below.
reason.workflow_invariant_violation: The run reached a state its pinned graph does not allow. This is a server-side fault, not something the submitter did.
reason.attempt_limit_exceeded: This step used up its attempts.
reason.rework_limit_exceeded: The run used up its rework rounds.
reason.step_limit_exceeded: The run reached its total step budget.
reason.duration_limit_exceeded: The run reached its time budget.
reason.cost_limit_exceeded: The run reached its cost budget.
reason.agent_task_failed: The agent's task failed before it could submit.
reason.agent_verdict_fail: The agent reported a failing verdict.
reason.agent_verdict_blocked: The agent reported that it is blocked.
reason.activation_timeout: The step was never picked up in time.

dialog.subtitle: Starts the published version. What you write here is what the first agent reads.
dialog.description_hint: Every agent step gets its own instruction plus this text. Without it the first agent has nothing concrete to work on.
dialog.description_placeholder: What happened, how to reproduce it, and what done looks like
dialog.field_required: {{label}} is required to start this run.
dialog.field_option_invalid: Pick one of the offered choices for {{label}}.
dialog.unpublished: Publish this workflow first — a run pins a published version, and this one has none.
dialog.archived: This workflow is archived, so it can no longer be run.
dialog.toast_unreadable: The run started but its details could not be read. Open the runs list to find it.

detail.unreadable: This run's details could not be read, so its trace is not shown. Nothing has been changed.
detail.input_empty: This run carries no readable input.
detail.trace_empty: No steps yet. The first step activates as soon as the run is routed.
detail.trace_lost: This run has {{count}} steps, but none of them could be read.
detail.graph_failed: Could not load the pinned graph. The trace is still available below.

acceptance.title: Your review is needed
acceptance.criteria_empty: The graph pinned no criteria for this gate.
acceptance.evidence_empty: The upstream step recorded no submission.
acceptance.reason_label: Why is this being sent back?
acceptance.reason_placeholder: What is wrong, and what would make it right
acceptance.reason_required: A rejection needs a reason: it becomes the brief for the rework attempt.
acceptance.targets_empty: This gate permits no rework, so the only decision available is Accept.

editor.validate_failed: The graph could not be checked with the server.

conflict.title: This draft changed elsewhere
conflict.body: Your working JSON is still here. Copy it, reload the latest draft, or retry your changes against the latest revision.
conflict.copy_failed: Could not copy the working JSON
conflict.reload_failed: Could not reload the latest draft

read_only.builtin: Built-in workflows cannot be edited. Duplicate it to change it.
read_only.archived: This workflow is archived, so it can no longer be edited.
read_only.role: Only workspace owners and admins can edit workflows.

publish_dirty.title: Publish without saving?
publish_dirty.body: A published version is frozen forever, and publishing now would freeze the last saved graph - not the one on screen.

input_instances.definition_failed: Unable to load the published workflow inputs. Retry before saving or running.
input_instances.changed: This input instance uses an earlier workflow version. Review the current fields before running or saving changes.
input_instances.removed: Fields no longer in this workflow: {{fields}}. Confirming removes them from this run only.
input_instances.delete_hint: Delete this saved input instance? Existing workflow runs will be kept.
input_instances.failed: Unable to save the input instance
input_instances.label: Input instance
input_instances.name: Instance name
input_instances.load_failed: Unable to load input instances. Reopen this dialog to try again.
input_instances.hint: Save named inputs and select one each time you run this workflow. Saving does not start a run.

node_actions.missing_entry: Choose an entry node before saving the workflow.
node_actions.hint: Select a node on the canvas and press Delete or Backspace. Use Undo to restore it.

instances.grouped_hint: Browse saved inputs grouped by their workflow.
instances.create_hint: Save these inputs for reuse. Creating an instance does not start a run.
instances.unbound: Pending version binding. Publish the workflow, then review and bind a version before running.
instances.unknown: Field {{field}} is not in this version. Keep it for review or explicitly remove it before running.
instances.remove_field: Remove this input value? Save changes to make the removal permanent.
instances.leave: You have unsaved instance changes. Leave and discard them?
instances.upgrade_hint: Review the input declaration before changing the version. Values stay in the editor until you explicitly save changes.
instances.keep_resources: Your instance image and project references are retained. Review them if the input mode changes.
instances.conflict: This instance was changed elsewhere. Your edits are preserved. Reload the latest instance or duplicate your edits.
instances.temporary_hint: Saving changes does not run. Temporary runs do not update the saved instance. Version changes must be saved before running.
instances.empty: No instances yet. Open a workflow and choose Save as instance.

graph_v2.rejected: Rejected; dependent work will be skipped.

authoring.invalid_port: Use a unique, nonempty port ID without surrounding spaces.
authoring.join_hint: Waits for all activated predecessors; skipped branches are not awaited.
authoring.label: Label changed
authoring.version_failed: Could not load the version. Close and reopen to retry.
